notes.title: Ven VR Adventure is available on SteamVR! [10% RELEASE DISCOUNT]
notes.notes:
We are pleased to inform you that Ven VR Adventure, our immersive and challenging 3D platformer game for virtual reality, is now available on SteamVR!

Our game is available with 10% RELEASE DISCOUNT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/21ea593ce6767fe4098ce39c9278e1c96a0ffe01.png

After the Oculus Rift release and SteamVR Beta, we analyzed all of the feedback from the players which helped us improve our game in various fields. The Steam version of Ven VR Adventure is updated with a large number of fixes as well as new functions and gameplay improvements. 

Changes were made in every location in the game which means better camera work in VR and more comfortable experience thanks to the Snap Turn option. What is more, we introduced difficulty levels, an indicator for collectibles, new tutorial tips and more!

If you will decide to play our game, don't forget to write the review on Steam! It will be very helpfull for us!

notes.title: Ven VR Adventure - PATCH 1.2 coming with the Steam version!
notes.notes:
Hello Community! Ven VR Adventure launches on Steam this week! We have the list of changes coming with the new patch. The update 1.2 will be already implemented in the Steam version on the release day, January 28th, so you will be playing an improved game at the start!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/6c5af4fde95e552286f0f55eb533ec8215ed29c0.png

Here is what we’ve been cooking for you the last couple of weeks:


 Places, where players had difficulty during gameplay because Ven was too far from them, were redesigned in every location in the game. It brings a lot of improvement to the gameplay but the base experience stays the same :) 


 Added difficulty levels to the game - the player can change them during profile creation as well as during gameplay.


 Difficulty levels do not affect level design but determine: number of checkpoints, lives for Ven at the start as well as runes and crates demanded to gain another life.


 Snap Turn Option - default on (improves the mechanics of looking around).


 Added hints in a form of new pictures in the tablet - a lot of players were not using special attack or they had problems with some game mechanics.


 Added an indicator of collected runes on the right-hand watch.


 Fixed problem with frogs - now they will always kill the player with one strike.


 A huge number of fixes and tweaks for the tutorial, menu and lobby.


 Various bug fixes, optimization and stability improvements.


Note: One the same day the update will be also available for Oculus Rift and Viveport users ;) 

Yours,
Monologic Games

notes.title: Ven VR Adventure - Info about Steam release
notes.notes:
Hello VR fans! We would like to clarify the situation with the Steam version of Ven VR Adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/401d56637202c9b4c6a2af95ca17db6e28fc5e01.png

As you might probably know, our game was released on  December 17 on Oculus Store. A lot of you were asking about the Steam version and here is the official info.

The Steam version of Ven VR Adventure is almost ready. However, we are a small independent studio and we can work on releasing each version one by one as we mentioned some time ago. 

Even if the game is ready in terms of the content, there are various technical differences when submitting the build for each platform. It will take us some more time to have the version ready for Steam release.

Ven VR Adventure will release on Steam in 2021 but you can expect it sooner rather than later - we will be back with the official date soon. 

Yours,
Monologic Games

notes.title: Ven VR Adventure - important info about the release
notes.notes:
Hello,


We have an important message about Ven VR Adventure for you today.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36714841/60f6b8ab29e74c313eccf84debd2877071285cdf.jpg


First of all, we would like to say a huge THANK YOU from the bottom of our hearts for supporting our game. We love bringing you new content every week and we are excited about all of your reactions. We would like to give you the high-quality VR platformer and it takes a lot of time to do it right.

That is why we want to inform you that Ven VR Adventure won’t be released in Q2 2020 and we want to apologize for that delay. We are a small indie studio and we still need a few additional months to bring our full vision to life. At the moment we do not provide any precise date - we can tell you that our goal is still to release the game in 2020.

As to the happy news, the progress we’ve made so far allows us to share more cool materials from the game! Stay tuned and watch our social media!

Yours,
Monologic Games
